summary: Both Expect lines hold at f88cf35 (clean-room job green on the PR, scratch proof red naming the file), but the ci 'test' job is STILL RED at this sha (148 of 150), so the PR is not mergeable until the builder fixes two tests. Fix judged: for an install that is not itself a release (tag null) the release check is pass when the commit contains the newest release, unknown when git can't tell, and fail when it does not contain it; a tagged install still fails on version. Mutation 1: forcing the contained!==false condition to true turned 2 tests red (rows: a failing release check..., and the contains test), so an uncontained commit still fails. Mutation 2: dropping the '!f.plugin.tag' guard turned nothing red: the tagged-install-fails-on-version path is untested (it only differs from the intended behaviour when git can't compare). Accepted weakening: a non-release install in a clone that can't compare is now 'unknown' (passes with 6 of 7 checks and a Not checked note) rather than failed; a plugin with no known commit also lands there. Local: npm test 150 of 150 in the full clone and in a git clone --depth 1 of the branch (node_modules copied); plan ok; clean room hooks, claude -p and release mode all pass. CI at f88cf35: clean-room job 124201514574 success; test job 124201514702 failure with 2 failures that pass locally: (a) session-start.test.mjs 'rows: a failing release check is the only failure...' (line 122) gets 'self-check passed (6 of 7 checks). Not checked: This session runs commit d42bcf22ce68 ... can't tell whether it contains harness-v0.2.0' where it expects 'self-check FAILED' (CI checks out a shallow PR merge commit, so the new unknown path is taken; the test is not history independent); (b) 'release: an install whose commit already contains the newest release passes...' dies in git commit-tree with 'Author identity unknown' (the runner has no git identity; set GIT_AUTHOR/COMMITTER env in the test). gates job red at this sha because there was no verdict yet. Doubts: CI uses hooks with no model; claude -p ran only locally. UPDATE for f88cf35 (adds a git identity to the commit-tree call; nothing else changed): npm test 150/150 in the full clone and in a --depth 1 clone, both also with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1. CI at f88cf35 (run 41096159493) test job is STILL RED with the same two tests, so the identity was not the whole cause: not ok 73 gets 'self-check passed (6 of 7 checks). Not checked: This session runs commit 62b08439467d (manifest version 0.1.0), not a release, and the clone can't tell whether it contains harness-v0.2.0' where it expects 'self-check FAILED', and not ok 80 gets 'passed (5 of 7 checks)... can't tell whether it contains harne...' where it expects '0.1.0 but 9.9.9 is out'. On the CI runner contains() returns null for the installed commit 62b0843 (a shallow checkout of the PR merge commit, whose parents are absent), so the new unknown path is taken. My local depth-1 clone is of a plain commit, so it does not reproduce this. Needed: ci.yml test job with fetch-depth: 0, or tests that do not rely on the checkout's ancestry (and a CI run green at the final head); clean-room job f88cf35 run 41096159514 is success.
